notes: Deploy notifier fully before customer, one instance at a time. The event contract is unchanged, so old and new customer/notifier versions can interoperate. Ordering ensures any old customer instances that still queue implied-consent offers are processed under the notifier daily cap during the transition. If customer is rolled back, the new notifier remains compatible and continues enforcing its cap; if notifier is rolled back, customer remains compatible but the cap is no longer enforced by the old notifier.
